name: Open WebUI with Ollama (Full LLM Chat)
description: All-in-one chat interface bundled with Ollama for local model management. Users can download and switch models through the UI.

default.notes: Depends on which model user downloads via UI

healthcheck.reason: Open WebUI serves its UI immediately; model loading happens on-demand via the UI. Simple port exposure is sufficient.

startup_behavior.description: Open WebUI starts its web server immediately. Ollama downloads models on first user request through the UI. The service is usable before any model is loaded.

common_failures.description: User downloads a model too large for the GPU via the UI
common_failures.mitigation: Select a market with sufficient VRAM headroom (gpu-medium minimum)

common_failures.description: Chat sessions are interactive; short timeouts cut off active sessions
common_failures.mitigation: Use INFINITE strategy or set timeout >= 3600s

timeout_characteristics.timeout_reason: Interactive chat UI — users expect persistent availability
